name: cookie-fortune-cards
description: Create daily browser-context and entertainment fortune Card/Event pairs for a Cookie-owned Card Space.

interface.shortDescription: Turn coarse browser context into daily Card/Event pairs.
interface.longDescription: Uses a claimed browser session, coarse language/platform context, and request time to create an idempotent context pair and an entertainment-only daily fortune pair.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create or refresh today's browser-context and entertainment fortune cards in my current Card Space.
